segments.ja372:1.3: Samaṇassa na taṃ sādhu, yaṃ petamanusocasi.
segments.ja372:2.1: Saṃvāsena have sakka, manussassa migassa vā;
segments.ja372:2.3: Hadaye jāyate pemaṃ, na taṃ sakkā asocituṃ.
segments.ja372:3.1: Mataṃ marissaṃ rodanti, ye rudanti lapanti ca;
segments.ja372:3.3: Tasmā tvaṃ isi mā rodi, roditaṃ moghamāhu santo.
segments.ja372:4.1: Roditena have brahme, mato peto samuṭṭhahe;
segments.ja372:5.1: Ādittaṃ vata maṃ santaṃ, ghatasittaṃva pāvakaṃ;
segments.ja372:5.3: Vārinā viya osiñcaṃ, sabbaṃ nibbāpaye daraṃ.
segments.ja372:6.1: Abbahi vata me sallaṃ, yamāsi hadayassitaṃ;
segments.ja372:7.3: Na socāmi na rodāmi, tava sutvāna vāsavāti.

lines: Tattha na taṃ sakkāti taṃ manussaṃ vā tiracchānaṃ vā na sakkā asocituṃ, socāmiyevāhanti.
“Mataṃ marissaṃ rodanti, ye rudanti lapanti ca;
Tasmā tvaṃ isi mā rodi, roditaṃ moghamāhu santo.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – ye loke matañca marissantañca rodanti, te rudanti ceva vilapanti ca, tesaṃ assupacchijjanadivaso nāma natthi.
Roditaṃ moghamāhu santoti, buddhādayo pana paṇḍitā roditaṃ “moghan”ti vadanti.
Mato petoti yo esa mato petoti vuccati, yadi so roditena samuṭṭhaheyya, evaṃ sante kiṃ nikkammā acchāma, sabbeva samāgamma aññamaññassa ñātake rodāma.
Yasmā pana te roditakāraṇā na uṭṭhahanti, tasmā roditassa moghabhāvaṃ sādheti.
